note: Constants of the stem-context proxy metrics (docs/SPEC.md 4.2 P-02, P-08, P-09, P-10, P-12, P-13, P-15, P-22; 4.11; 8.1). Every value is an initial [model] or [practice] value subject to calibration (4.9). The spreading function is a two-slope Bark-domain model with a level-dependent upper slope (Terhardt-style); it is a coarse excitation model, not a full auditory model. Read by core/analysis/stems.py.

analysis.note: Power spectra (channel-averaged, Hann, ~46 ms frames, 50 % hop) are summed into 1-ERB bands. Before any level-dependent step the stems are scaled by one common gain so that the summed mix has mix_reference_rms_dbfs (level match, R-01); relative stem levels are untouched. full_scale_spl_db maps the normalized digital level to an assumed playback SPL for the level-dependent slope and the threshold in quiet.

spreading.note: Attenuation from a masker band j to a band i: lower side (i below j) lower_slope * dz; upper side (i above j) s_u * dz with s_u = base + freq_term / f_masker - level_coeff * L_masker_spl, clipped to [min, max]. Louder maskers spread further upward (upward spread of masking, 8.1). Excitations of different stems add in power.

masking.note: Masked threshold of a target band = power sum of the other stems' spread excitation + threshold_offset_db. buried dB = max(0, threshold - target band level), capped. Bands where the target is below the threshold in quiet carry no weight. Per frame, bands are weighted by the target's own band power; frames where the target is active are averaged with equal weight.

activity_gate.note: A frame is active when its level is above both abs_dbfs and (95th percentile frame level - rel_db_below_p95). The absolute gate is applied to the un-normalized stem.

regions_hz.note: Region membership of an ERB band is decided by its centre frequency.

penalties.note: Penalty = 0 while the value is inside [0, ok_max]; outside, with d the distance to the bound, 1 - exp(-(d / scale)^2) (shared range_penalty of core/analysis/perceptual.py: ~0.63 at one scale, ~0.98 at two).

sidechain_sim.note: time_axis: the bass excitation is ducked by depth_db * trigger (trigger from the kick-band envelope, instant attack, exponential release reaching 90 % recovery after the release time). Unmasking = kick buried dB before - after. With a bpm the release is the note value release_note (R-11); the kick decay time (to -kick_decay_db) is compared with 1/16, 1/8 and 1/4 notes.

importance_defaults.note: Default stem importance when the project gives none: the group order from knowledge/genre_priors.json (default_stem_importance_order, or the genre's stem_importance_order) mapped onto these values (rank 1 = lead). A declared importance always wins (4.11).

p08.note: index = 10*log10((E(2 f0) + E(3 f0)) / E(f0)); each band is h*f0 +/- halfwidth*f0. Penalty when the index is below target_index_db_min (too little upper-harmonic support for small speakers, OF-1/OF-5). Missing-fundamental check: high-pass at missing_fundamental_hp_hz, re-run the periodicity estimator and count frames whose pitch stays within pitch_agree_cents of the original.

p09.note: Closeness = weighted sum of z-scores across stems (level of active frames, blind D/R, high-frequency ratio, pre-delay proxy); depth = -closeness. Penalty = (1 - Kendall tau) / 2 against the declared front-to-back order; without a declared order, the lead is expected in front and penalty = lead rank / (n - 1).

p10.note: Lead clarity-band (300 Hz - 5 kHz) level minus the accompaniment (sum of every other stem) in the same band, over frames where the lead is active. Below the target band -> 'buried', above -> 'floating'. Genre priors (knowledge/genre_priors.json p10_target_db) override the generic band; a prior with only a relative label uses relative_targets_db.

p12.note: Band crest (peak - RMS over active frames) per P-22 band and attack-to-body energy ratio around onsets detected on the 'before' signal. Penalty from the mean band crest loss and the attack-ratio loss (mean of the two).

p13.note: cents = 1200 * log2(f_bass / f_kick). Beating risk is 0 within in_tune_cents, rises to 1 at risk_full_cents[0], stays 1 to risk_full_cents[1] and falls to 0 at separate_cents. The tonic is folded into tonic_fold_hz; below use_fundamental_min_hz the policy hint is harmonic completion (R-16).

p15.note: Blind estimates on music, not room measurements: RT60 from free-decay slopes after envelope peaks (T20 when 20 dB of decay are available, T10 otherwise), D/R from early (direct) vs late energy after onsets. Sustained notes read as reverberant. Rough; report as such.

p22.note: A stem owns a band in a section when its band energy is within within_db of the loudest stem in that band and carries at least min_share of the band energy. Bands more than band_floor_db_below_mix below the section's mix energy are skipped (empty). Target: 1-2 owners per band (R-28).
